request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; architecture assessment by Q3 2027; specific milestone durations range from 6 to 52 weeks.
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including node and wallet backend upgrades, hard fork readiness, platform support, release engineering, and signed releases.
Ecosystem expansion including Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, CIP-30 dApp connector, and Japanese localisation.
User support across GitHub, community forums, direct channels, and Japanese-language support.
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation.
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc., with administration and disbursement through Intersect as described in the proposal.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Daedalus Wallet maintenance and improvements for 2026-2027 as a time-and-materials engagement.

claims.claim: Daedalus is Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet and derives wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, with the true count claimed to be meaningfully higher.

Se7en Labs assumed responsibility for Daedalus under an IOG contract in January 2026 and has shipped Mithril Snapshot Bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, the drt release CLI, and Nix build modernization since then.
The proposal commits to a compatible Daedalus stable release at least two weeks before every mainnet hard fork during the contract period.

The requested budget totals 1,785,333 ADA, consisting of 1,666,667 ADA for maintenance and improvements, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and a 52,000 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Any unspent labor, hardware, or audit budget at contract close will be returned to the treasury.
All release-timing and version-currency metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain without relying on applicant self-reporting.
The proposal says the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

Intersect is described as the administrator and independent milestone verifier, with monthly disbursements against verified work and funds held in a dedicated auditable account before disbursement to Se7en Labs.

The proposal identifies major risks including ADA/USD volatility, upstream cardano-node API changes, Leios/Peras complexity, platform dependency changes, and team continuity, and provides mitigations for each.

summary: The proposal requests 1,785,333 ADA for Se7en Labs to maintain and improve Daedalus over a 2026-2027 contract year, with Intersect administration, milestone verification, public-good/open-source framing, and deliverables spanning protocol maintenance, hard fork readiness, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, Japanese localisation, user support, and an architecture assessment.
